question: Kolhapur city is located on the banks of which of the following rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Panchganga.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kolhapur** is a city in the Indian state of Maharashtra.
 
• It is located on the banks of river **Panchganga.**__
 
• Because of its spiritual history and the antiquity of its shrine Mahalaxmi, Kolhapur is known as '**Dakshin Kashi**' or Kashi of the South.
 
• Kolhapur is famed for its hand-crafted and braided leather slippers known as Kolhapuri chappal, which was awarded **Geographical Indication status in 2019.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• The **Panchganga River**__, located in Maharashtra, is one of India's most important rivers.
 
• It is a major tributary of the **Krishna River**, joining it at Narsobawadi.
 
• It flows through the borders of Kolhapur city.
 
• It originates from** Prayag Sangam.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The** Sarayu** is a river in Uttarakhand, India, that originates on a ridge south of the Nanda Kot mountain.

 
 
• The river is mentioned several times in the Ramayana, an ancient Indian epic.
 
• It flows through the Kumaon Himalayas, passing past the cities of Kapkot, Bageshwar, and Seraghat on its way to Pancheshwar, where it joins the Sharda River.
 
 
 
• The **Chambal River **is a tributary of the Yamuna River.
 
 
• The river forms the boundary between Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh before turning southeast to join the Yamuna in Uttar Pradesh state.
 
 
 
• **Musi River **is a tributary of the Krishna River in the Deccan Plateau.
 
 
• It flows through Telangana state in India.
 
• The river originates in Ananthagiri Hills near Vikarabad in Telangana.
